name: SSHI_simplified
rationale: The FBR fails on S2 (heavy load) and S4 (weak excitation) due to diode drops and poor impedance matching. A Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) approach uses an inductor to flip the piezo voltage, significantly increasing the extracted energy. I use a half-bridge SSHI with a rectifier to the storage capacitor. The SYNC controller flips the voltage at the peaks, and the DSCH diodes steer the current to the output.
